buffet.title: Four worlds, one plate
buffet.lead: Walk around, try a bit of everything, go back for your favourites. Here's what's waiting for you.

grill.title: The grill
grill.text: Meats, skewers and fish cooked to order on the griddle. You choose, we sear, you leave with a hot plate.

sushis.title: Sushi
sushis.text: Maki, California rolls, sushi and sashimi, next to stir-fried noodles and other Asian dishes.

fruitsDeMer.title: Seafood
fruitsDeMer.text: Prawns, mussels and shellfish, cold or cooked, for those who like to start with the sea.

desserts.title: Desserts
desserts.text: Cakes, fruit, creams and ice cream: the kids' favourite counter, and often the parents' too.

buffet.also: Also: a big counter of starters, crudités and salads, and hot dishes that change from day to day.

grill.title: Cooked in front of you, served piping hot
grill.text: Nothing waits under a heat lamp at the grill. Point to what you fancy, the cook sears it on the griddle and hands it over a few minutes later.

groups.title: Big tables are what we do every day
groups.text: Birthdays, family meals, end-of-year dinners with colleagues: the dining room is large and we set your table in advance. Let us know, we'll take care of the rest.

kids.title: Everyone fills their own plate
kids.text: Children love choosing for themselves, from the grill to the desserts. Under 10s have their own price, lunch and dinner.

items.a: It's not compulsory, but it's recommended in the evening and at weekends, and essential for groups. Book online or call +33 9 54 66 98 88.
We serve lunch from 12 to 2:30 pm and dinner from 7 pm. Today's hours and whether we're open right now are shown live on this page.

items.q: How much is the buffet for a child?
items.a: The buffet is €12.90 for children under 10, lunch and dinner, with proof of age. See the Prices section for details.

items.q: Can we come as a group of 15 or 20 for a birthday?
items.a: Yes, it's something we do all the time. Mention the occasion and the number of guests in the form, and we'll call you back to organise your table.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Card and cash. For meal vouchers and Chèques-Vacances, please ask at the front desk or by phone.

items.q: I have an allergy, what should I do?
items.a: Tell the team when you arrive and we'll point out the dishes concerned. The allergen list is available on request.

buffetAmiens.title: All-you-can-eat buffet near Amiens
intro: Looking for an all-you-can-eat restaurant around Amiens where everyone finds something they love? Au Comptoir de Longueau, in Boves, brings a grill, a sushi counter, seafood, starters and desserts under one roof.
You pay one price per person, then help yourself as often as you like. Simple and generous, which is why families and groups keep coming back.

sections.title: A few minutes from Amiens
sections.text: The restaurant is in Boves, in the Longueau area, at 15 bis rue Michel Strogoff. It's a short drive from central Amiens, with a large car park at the entrance.

sections.title: One buffet, four worlds
sections.text: The grill, where meats and fish are seared to order; sushi and Asian dishes; seafood; and the big dessert counter. In between, starters and hot dishes that change from day to day.

sections.title: Lunch, dinner and weekends
sections.text: The buffet is served at lunch and dinner. The price depends on the time of the week, and children have a price adapted to their age.

sections.title: Made for groups
sections.text: Birthdays, family meals, team outings: the dining room welcomes big tables. Book and mention the occasion, and we'll call you back to arrange everything.

sushisBoves.title: All-you-can-eat sushi in Boves
intro: Craving sushi without counting? At Au Comptoir de Longueau, the sushi counter is part of the big buffet: maki, California rolls, sushi and sashimi, as many times as you like.
And since not everyone wants the same thing, the grill, seafood and desserts are right next to it.

sections.title: The sushi counter
sections.text: Trays of maki, California rolls, sushi and sashimi, refilled throughout service, with soy sauce, ginger and wasabi.

sections.title: With the rest of the buffet
sections.text: Sushi is included in the buffet price, along with grilled meats, seafood, starters, hot dishes and desserts.
